mapper.select: SELECT o.*, s.name AS shop_name, s.address AS shop_address, u.nickname AS user_name FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN shops AS s ON o.shop_id = s.id LEFT JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, shop_id, order_type, total_amount, status, appointment_time, appointment_end_time, appointment_duration, appointment_pet_name, shipping_address, items) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{shopId}, #{orderType}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{appointmentTime}, #{appointmentEndTime}, #{appointmentDuration}, #{appointmentPetName}, #{shippingAddress}, #{items})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT o.*, s.name AS shop_name, s.address AS shop_address, u.nickname AS user_name FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN shops AS s ON o.shop_id = s.id LEFT JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.order_type = 'booking' AND o.status = 'confirmed' AND COALESCE(o.appointment_end_time, o.appointment_time) < NOW()

SELECT DISTINCT o.* FROM orders o INNER JOIN order_appointment_slots oas ON oas.order_id = o.id INNER JOIN appointment_slots s ON s.id = oas.slot_id WHERE s.service_id = #{serviceId} AND s.shop_id = #{shopId} AND s.slot_date = #{slotDate} AND o.order_type = 'booking' AND o.status = 'confirmed' AND o.appointment_time > NOW() ORDER BY o.appointment_time

SELECT o.*, s.name AS shop_name, s.address AS shop_address, u.nickname AS user_name FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN shops AS s ON o.shop_id = s.id LEFT JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.order_type = 'booking' AND o.status = 'confirmed' AND o.appointment_time > #{from} AND o.appointment_time <= #{to} ORDER BY o.appointment_time ASC

SELECT o.*, s.name AS shop_name, s.address AS shop_address, u.nickname AS user_name FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN shops AS s ON o.shop_id = s.id LEFT JOIN users AS u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.order_type = 'product' AND o.status = 'pending_payment' AND o.created_at < #{createdBefore} ORDER BY o.created_at ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'cancelled' WHERE order_type = 'booking' AND status = 'confirmed' AND COALESCE(appointment_end_time, appointment_time) < NOW()
